sources.title: Attractions | Yomiuriland Amusement Park
facts: The operator lists 44 attractions, including coasters, car-themed experiences, shooting games and an original-knitting activity.
The footer identifies Yomiuriland at 4015-1 Yanokuchi, Inagi, matching the supplied target.
limitations: Only the attractions catalog was opened; linked event, illumination and neighboring-facility pages were not inspected.
A ride catalog cannot exclude additional cultural or artistic programming.
